newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares edge higher despite profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares edge higher despite profit-taking.

text.p: Lima shares edged slightly higher overall despite profit-taking in leading shares towards the end of the session, brokers said.
"At the close, many of the leaders, especially in the mining and electricity sectors, fell after maintaining a long, positive leaning," said Rolando Viale, of Rentaval brokerage.
Analysts predicted losses on Friday, with the probable exception of the brewery sector, which is recovering after previous falls on first half results.
On Thursday, the General Index rose 0.59 percent to 1,438.42 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index was off 0.02 percent to 1,973.12.
Total market volume was 26.9 million soles ($10.8 million) in 2,538 trades as 33 shares rose, 27 fell and 34 ended flat.
Among leaders, brewery Cervecera Del Sur gained 3.23 percent to 1.60 sol on 238,456 shares, while another brewery Backus y Johnston gained 2.05 percent to 2.49 soles on 1.05 million shares.
Benchmark Telefnica del Per edged down 0.69 percent to 5.74 soles on 544,533 shares -- 11.65 percent of volume -- while electricity company Edegel lost 3.38 percent to 6.01 soles on 300,996 shares.

"Although the bolsa could experience some light corrections (in coming days), the positive economic forecasts for Peru suggest an attractive market in general," said Jos Mrquez of Abila y Calpe brokerage.
